classification: post-hoc defensive-asset trend experiment on the R342 C-satellite portfolio
hypothesis: The R342 recent fresh-start losses were driven by the gold sleeve, not the stock sleeves. Switching the gold sleeve to a 50/50 treasury-plus-dividend proxy when gold closes below its 200-day moving average should improve fresh-start stability and MDD without changing stock selection or concentration.
disclosure: R342 passed 5x cost and concentration but failed recent fresh starts. Component attribution showed equity was positive in both failed phases, while the gold sleeve contributed roughly -3.5% and -2.6%. The 200-day gold rule is a single classic trend rule, not a lookback grid. It is first evaluated here with full portfolio gates.

base_portfolio.sleeve_weighting: monthly 60-day inverse-volatility risk parity with [0.20,0.60] bounds; C capped at 10% and excess redistributed to A/B
base_portfolio.overlay: 60-day lookback, 15% balance-vol target, gross [0.2,1.0], no leverage

gold_proxy_rule.signal: At each month-start close, gold is ON if close > mean(close over trailing 200 trading days), otherwise OFF.
gold_proxy_rule.off_return: 50% treasury daily return + 50% dividend daily return
gold_proxy_rule.switch_cost: one-third portfolio turnover at the prevailing overlay round-trip cost on a regime switch
gold_proxy_rule.warmup: before 200 gold closes, gold is ON
gold_proxy_rule.leakage_control: the signal at date t is applied only to returns after t

data.D1: all sleeves load and produce full curves
data.D2: gold/treasury/dividend proxy series align over the full window

concentration.C12: max weight sum <=1, min target weight >=0

robustness.R2_gold: 159937.SZ replacement through the same proxy annual >=5%, MDD >= -20%, 2024/2025 >=0
robustness.F1_fresh: at least 4/5 fresh starts positive and every MDD >= -18%
robustness.P1_overlay: >=7/9 overlay lookback/target variants pass core gates
robustness.P2_joint: >=2/3 joint target variants pass core gates

satellite_cap_plateau.per_cap_core: 2x annual >=12%, Sharpe >=1.25, MDD >= -15%; 5x annual >=10%, Sharpe >=1.10, MDD >= -15%; 5x C2-C4 pass; at least 4/5 fresh starts positive
satellite_cap_plateau.P4: at least 3/4 caps pass and the 10% center passes

selection_rule: All D/G/X/C/R/F/P gates and P4 must pass. Otherwise record negative result and do not promote. No threshold changes after results.
discipline: Only the gold defensive composition changes from R342.
No stock strategy, score, position count, holding period, C cap or overlay grid is altered.
The 200-day signal is fixed before the run and is not scanned.
No leverage; no paper target or order file.
known_limitations: The gold trend rule and 10% C cap are post-hoc.
Common window starts in 2023; not a full 2018-2026 validation.
Gold, treasury and dividend ETF qfq series are not official PIT total-return benchmarks.
The proxy does not model intraday execution or ETF premium/discount.
